source.identity: Apple, Logic Pro User Guide for Mac

entries.name: Pointer
entries.documentedBehavior: Selects, moves, Option-copies, resizes, and in supported contexts loops items; its click zones can temporarily become Fade, Loop, or Marquee behavior.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Selection, click zone, modifiers, snap, focus, and item type determine the edit; one gesture is not one invariant operation.

entries.name: Pencil
entries.documentedBehavior: Creates regions or events and can select, move, loop, or resize them; in Score it also creates notation symbols.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Created MIDI notes inherit prior/default length, velocity, and channel; Score symbols and playable events are different state.

entries.name: Eraser
entries.documentedBehavior: Deletes a clicked item and, when the clicked item is selected, can delete every currently selected item.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Selection broadening makes a local-looking click a multi-item deletion; host undo availability is not guaranteed to be a complete safety transaction.

entries.name: Text
entries.documentedBehavior: Renames regions or objects and creates text in the Score Editor.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Names and imported text are untrusted metadata; score text is not an acoustic instruction or executable authority.

entries.name: Scissors
entries.documentedBehavior: Splits regions or events at the edit position and applies to all selected items.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Snap, zero-crossing behavior, take/folder state, and selection determine the actual boundary and number of affected items.

entries.name: Join
entries.documentedBehavior: Joins selected regions or events into a single region or event.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Joining audio, MIDI, looped, Flex-enabled, take, or folder material has different conversion and asset consequences; source identity must be rechecked.

entries.name: Solo
entries.documentedBehavior: Auditions a held region or event in isolation and scrubs items crossed by horizontal movement.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: This is an audition gesture, not a committed mute/solo mix state; transport focus and monitoring route remain relevant.

entries.name: Mute
entries.documentedBehavior: Toggles item mute state; if multiple items are selected, the clicked item's resulting state applies to all selected items.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Mute is stateful and selection-broadened; it is not deletion, bypass, silence trimming, or track mute.

entries.name: Zoom
entries.documentedBehavior: Changes view magnification around a dragged area and can restore the prior/default zoom.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Zoom affects evidence visibility and click precision but not audio; it must never be reported as a production edit.

entries.name: Fade
entries.documentedBehavior: Creates and edits fades and fade-curve shapes on supported material.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Fade, crossfade, loop, region edge, and file-edge behavior differ; a fade can change attack, sustain, clicks, or overlap without changing the source file.

entries.name: Automation Select
entries.documentedBehavior: Selects automation data and can create automation points at region borders.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Parameter identity, automation scope, mode, snap, Move Automation with Regions, and locks must be explicit before an edit.

entries.name: Automation Curve
entries.documentedBehavior: Bends the segment between two automation points to form a nonlinear transition.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: The visible curve is host automation data, not proof of a plug-in's audible smoothing or exact sample trajectory.

entries.name: Marquee
entries.documentedBehavior: Selects time-bounded portions of regions for editing, playback, and Selection-Based Processing.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: A marquee defines scope but does not identify a source asset, track, take, or safe operation; subsequent commands determine material consequences.

entries.name: Flex
entries.documentedBehavior: Creates or edits fundamental Flex timing controls without requiring the full Flex view.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Flex algorithm, tempo metadata, File Tempo, Follow Tempo/Pitch, groups, takes, and transient/tempo markers interact; timing edits can create artifacts.

entries.name: Slip
entries.documentedBehavior: Moves content inside fixed region boundaries by the Snap value when extra source content exists.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Session Player regions are first converted to MIDI, losing generative semantics; source availability, snap, and boundaries constrain the move.

entries.name: Rotate
entries.documentedBehavior: Moves region content while wrapping overflow to the opposite edge.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Rotating audio converts it to a one-track folder containing two regions; Session Player regions convert to MIDI first.

entries.name: Finger
entries.documentedBehavior: Resizes MIDI notes from anywhere in Piano Roll and moves selected steps to another position or lane in Step Editor.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Area focus changes the operation; multi-note/step selection and modifiers can preserve or overwrite relative differences.

entries.name: Quantize
entries.documentedBehavior: Applies the active quantize value to clicked or selected MIDI events.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Grid value, strength, swing, Q-range, region parameters, and destructive versus playback quantization scope must be distinguished.

entries.name: Velocity
entries.documentedBehavior: Adjusts MIDI note velocity for individual or selected notes.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Velocity may control level, timbre, articulation, modulation, or nothing depending on the instrument; it is not a measured dB change.

entries.name: Brush
entries.documentedBehavior: Paints MIDI notes or a defined brush pattern using current time-quantize and optional scale constraints.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: It can create many events quickly and inherits pattern, quantize, key/scale, velocity, channel, and snap context.

entries.name: Vibrato
entries.documentedBehavior: Adjusts detected Flex Pitch note vibrato by dragging vertically.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Requires Flex Pitch analysis; note segmentation and analysis can be wrong, and vibrato amount is not ordinary pitch correction.

entries.name: Volume
entries.documentedBehavior: Adjusts gain for an analyzed audio note by dragging vertically.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Per-note gain depends on Flex Pitch note boundaries and differs from region gain, clip gain, automation, fader level, compression, and normalization.

entries.name: Move
entries.documentedBehavior: Moves a selected section left or right within the audio file editor.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: The Audio File Editor is a destructive shared-file domain; aliases, other regions, backups, zero crossings, and source hashes must be considered.

entries.name: Camera
entries.documentedBehavior: Selects and exports a Page-view score section as an image.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Creates a derivative image file and depends on engraving/page state; it does not render audio or prove playback state.

entries.name: Layout
entries.documentedBehavior: Moves notation graphically without changing MIDI event timing, subject to item-specific positioning rules.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Graphical position and playback position are distinct; moving some bar-level layout objects can still affect surrounding engraving.

entries.name: Resize
entries.documentedBehavior: Changes the displayed size of notes and supported score symbols.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: This is notation presentation, not MIDI velocity, duration, arrangement density, or audible level.

entries.name: Voice Separation
entries.documentedBehavior: Draws a split line that assigns notes to predefined voice MIDI channels.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: It changes event-channel/voice assignment and may affect routing or articulation; it is not source separation or audio demixing.

entries.name: Line
entries.documentedBehavior: Creates or edits a linear series of event-beam values; it can edit MIDI events but cannot create MIDI note events.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: Lane/event definition, grid, existing events, and line endpoints determine the affected data; it is not an audio envelope.

entries.name: MIDI Thru
entries.documentedBehavior: Assigns the clicked Environment object to the selected track in the main window.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: This is host MIDI-routing authority outside TrackSmith's AU and can redirect external or internal destinations; it remains unsupported.

entries.name: Gain
entries.documentedBehavior: Applies nondestructive audio-region gain in dB to whole regions, selected regions, or a marquee selection.
entries.productionConsequenceAndRisk: It differs from file gain, normalization, track fader, automation, plug-in gain, and loudness; selection scope and headroom require validation.
